text:
Terrible experience. I called to inquire about a promotion for transferring my case, asking detailed questions about clearing the braces and installing the dental appliance. The staff said it wouldn't exceed 5000 baht, so I decided to go in. Upon arrival, the dentist removed my braces and told me to go to another room for tartar removal. In that room, the dentist just filled my tooth without removing the tartar. After that, I went to the counter and paid 4890 baht. I argued that I hadn't had tartar removed, but the staff insisted the dentist had. I emphasized three times that I hadn't had it done, but the staff still insisted it had. So I left. Feeling uneasy, I called the clinic again at home. I explained that I hadn't had tartar removed, and the staff checked and confirmed the dentist said it hadn't been done. Um, the 4890 baht I paid included removing the braces, filling one tooth, and taking impressions. So we decided not to continue treatment here and asked for the impression sheet to use at another clinic. The staff said it wasn't possible; if we wanted it, we would have to pay an additional 1000 baht.
In summary:
If we want to continue treatment, we will have to pay:
- Impressions: 1900 baht
- Filling: 900 baht
- Braces removal: 2000 baht
- Braces attachment: 8000 baht
Total: 12800 baht
When I called initially, they said it wouldn't exceed 5000 baht.
